content:
Apple TV today released the trailer for "Nocturne," a brand-new thriller series adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling crime novel "The Sandman."

"Nocturne" is a brand-new thriller series premiering on 30 October

Apple TV's library features a wide variety of outstanding crime and thriller series, and they plan to add even more this autumn.

One of them is "Nocturne," adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling novel "The Sandman."

"Nocturne" will premiere its first two episodes on Friday, 30 October, followed by one new episode each week until 25 December.

The series revolves around a serial killer and stars Liev Schreiber and Zazie Beetz, with Stephen Graham ("Adolescence") playing the killer.

Apple has just released the trailer, giving everyone a first look at this chilling new series. Below is the official synopsis for "Nocturne," followed by the trailer.

Two weeks before "Nocturne" airs, "12 12 12" will premiere on Apple TV — another crime thriller. The series stars Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan and tells the story of a heist, covering 12 months of planning, the 12-hour operation itself, and the 12 days that follow.

Looking beyond autumn, Apple plans to kick off 2027 with the highly anticipated thriller "The Wanted Man," starring Hugh Laurie as a crime syndicate leader.

Are you planning to watch "Nocturne" when it premieres next month? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs US$14.99 per month, or you can get a discounted bundle through Apple One.
